scripts.build: npm run build --workspace slave && npm run build --workspace console
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace slave && npm run typecheck --workspace console
scripts.test: bash scripts/local.sh test npm run test --workspace slave
scripts.db:migrate: bash scripts/local.sh db-check && bash scripts/local.sh exec npm run db:migrate --workspace slave
scripts.test:console: bash scripts/local.sh test npm run test:e2e --workspace console
